summary: IVX Holdings platform is now FULLY INDEPENDENT from Rork. All Rork Toolkit proxy dependencies, Rork SDK packages, Rork Metro wrappers, and Rork environment variable references have been removed. IVX now uses direct provider APIs exclusively: Vercel AI Gateway (vck_ key) for speech-to-text (xai/grok-stt) and text-to-speech (xai/grok-tts), and OpenAI (sk- key) as fallback. The Expo mobile app no longer depends on @rork-ai/toolkit-sdk or withRorkMetro. All endpoints verified working end-to-end on production.

removedDependencies.before: v1.2.0 had 3 provider paths: Rork Toolkit proxy (EXPO_PUBLIC_TOOLKIT_URL + EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_TOOLKIT_SECRET_KEY) → Direct Gateway → OpenAI
removedDependencies.after: v2.0.0 has 2 provider paths only: Direct Vercel AI Gateway (vck_ key) → OpenAI direct (sk- key). No Rork Toolkit proxy.

removedDependencies.before: Checked EXPO_PUBLIC_TOOLKIT_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_TOOLKIT_SECRET_KEY for toolkit proxy availability
removedDependencies.after: Toolkit proxy hardwired to available=false with note 'Rork toolkit proxy removed — IVX is fully independent'. Env var checks removed.
Uses default Expo Metro config only (getDefaultConfig). No withRorkMetro wrapper.
@rork-ai/toolkit-sdk removed from dependencies entirely (59 deps remaining, none Rork)

proofDefinition: IVX Holdings is now fully independent from Rork. All 4 Rork dependencies removed: (1) Rork Toolkit proxy in TTS service replaced with direct Vercel AI Gateway, (2) Rork toolkit references in landing-go-live API removed, (3) withRorkMetro wrapper removed from Expo Metro config, (4) @rork-ai/toolkit-sdk removed from Expo package.json. All 6 QA tests passed on production at commit 5a2c399927ef: health, voice chat status, TTS, transcription, full end-to-end voice chat, and 112 agents. IVX uses direct provider APIs exclusively — no Rork intermediary.
